catalogReplay.note: Published price payload with synthetic consumption; no inference, credentials, network request or invoice verification.

behaviorCovered: Ordered conditional overrides and deep cache/TTL merges precede all matching nested price multipliers.
Explicit token, character, image, megapixel, second, minute and search meters preserve their units; unsupported pricing fields do not silently become USD.
Reasoning uses its own rate or the appropriately multiplied output rate; missing TTLs, cache modes, storage meters and required condition facts stay unresolved.
Provider-reported nonnegative USD including zero wins; configured token rates retain precedence over rich catalog estimates.
New step settlements and auxiliary usage records retain reported, estimated or unknown assessment. Historical numeric amounts and unclassified legacy records remain unchanged.
Actual runner admission, execution and projection with TestLLM records a conditional estimate and a later unresolved estimate without losing the known subtotal.
Persisted Bus/database projections preserve assessments; stats derive coverage and budgets count unknown usage across descendants without duplicating numeric charges or compaction summaries.
Schema metadata omits absent fields; coverage rejects negative or fractional counts and Client exports retain canonical Schema identities.
limits: No frontend rendering changes, deployed browser validation, live inference, billing reconciliation, push, remote CI or publication.
V1 remains the default/bundled catalog; V2 rich estimates apply to configured V2 sources when no explicit token cost projection exists.
Automatic detailed media/native-tool/cache metering and remaining client cost-coverage presentations are pending. V2 media/native-tool requests without provider-reported USD remain unresolved.
Unknown charges contribute numeric zero for compatibility and retain explicit unknown assessment; they do not imply free usage or guarantee an external dollar cap.
Stats coverage follows existing accounting scopes: per-model assistant records and overall compaction records; title usage remains excluded there but included in budgets.
Tests are the focused subsets listed above, not the entire repository suite. Existing broad Schema contract-hygiene debt remains outside this batch.
